feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Political consultant on the impact of Republicans' gerrymandering efforts
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with political consultant Mike Madrid about how Republicans' gerrymandering efforts have backfired.

entry.title: Four Corners region faces flood threat after days of heavy rain
entry.summary: The area where four states meet in the U.S. Southwest remains on a flood watch after days of heavy rain and winds.

entry.title: Republicans are spending millions and still may not win districts drawn to favor them
entry.summary: Republicans redrew congressional district lines to try to tilt the midterms in their favor. But now they are facing expensive and competitive races they had hoped to outmaneuver.

entry.title: Court ruling fails to end wait for thousands of immigrants stuck abroad without visas
entry.summary: A federal judge struck down a Trump administration ban on issuing immigrant visas to people from 75 countries, but immigrants continue to be stuck in their countries.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Republicans' gerrymandering efforts have led to expensive and competitive races, Brazil's President Lula elected for fourth term, protests sweep parts of Europe.

entry.title: Journalist Calum Marsh discusses his new book, 'The Glass Box'
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with journalist Calum Marsh about his new book, "The Glass Box: The Shocking True History of How CrossFit Broke the Rules, Made Millions, and Changed Fitness Forever."

entry.title: Merck's melanoma vaccine trial shows reduced recurrence or death from skin cancer
entry.summary: Merck presented its mRNA melanoma vaccine trial data at a European cancer conference this weekend. Results are promising: The vaccine reduces recurrence and death alongside an immunotherapy drug.

entry.title: Some people with meat allergies from alpha-gal syndrome turn to exotic alternatives
entry.summary: People with Alpha-Gal Syndrome can have allergic reactions to meat from mammals. Many of those affected change their diets to eat other proteins.

entry.title: Venezuela's opposition leader María Corina Machado returns from exile
entry.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner María Corina Machado returns home after 10 months abroad, in a move that could challenge the country's interim leadership.

entry.title: Russia says it will open humanitarian corridor to Ukrainian town
entry.summary: Russia says it will open a humanitarian corridor to the occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, where people have been eating weeds and pickles to survive while trapped by minefields, shelling and drones.
